findings.source_quote: ". . .a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish" (Eph. 5:27).
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the Portuguese phrasing "antes que seja santa e irrepreensível" with a clearer rendering of the adversative "but". Use "mas que seja santa e irrepreensível" to preserve the original contrastive meaning.
findings.translation_quote: ". . .uma igreja gloriosa, que não tenha mancha, nem ruga, nem coisa semelhante; antes que seja santa e irrepreensível" (Efés. 5:27).
